$comment: Fast workflow preset — 'code + review'. Selected when a task's mode is 'fast' (see WorkflowPipelineService.resolvePipelinePath). Skips analysis, spec and the human approval gate: the agent goes straight to implementation, then the code-reviewer grades the rubric (required — never skippable). The two optional tail phases default OFF for fast tasks (disabledSteps = ['ui_verification','documentation']) but the user may re-enable either. There is no 'spec' phase to set uiScope, so 'implementation' carries "sets":["uiScope"]: the lifecycle skill writes uiScope at the start of implementation (none, unless the change is user-visible AND ui_verification is enabled). Same shape and runners as pipeline.json so the board and checker read it identically.

phases.label: Implementation
phases.description: Implements the task with tests (mandatory hard gate). Writes uiScope at the start since there is no spec phase.

phases.label: Review
phases.description: Code-reviewer subagent grades the rubric — any FAIL blocks shipping. Required in fast mode.

phases.label: UI verification
phases.description: Drives the app in a real browser to verify the UI.

phases.label: Documentation
phases.description: Writes/updates project docs and finalises the manual test guide.
